knowledge_items.description: Troubleshooting flow chart for over voltage.
knowledge_items.remedy: Check that the voltage is within specification (reduce voltage to be within spec.). When OV occurs check if the DC BUS voltage is greater than the protection value. Increase deceleration/acceleration time, reduce moment of load inertia, consider using a braking unit or DC braking; if OV occurs without load the drive may have malfunction due to noise, contact DELTA.

knowledge_items.title: Low voltage (Lv)
knowledge_items.description: Troubleshooting flow chart for low voltage.
knowledge_items.remedy: Check input power is correct (power cut incl. momentary loss); check for malfunctioning components or disconnection in the power supply circuit; check voltage is within specification; check for heavy load with high start current in the same power system (suitable transformer power capacity); check if voltage between +/B1 and - is greater than 200VDC (115V/230V models) or 400VDC (460V models); otherwise contact DELTA.

knowledge_items.title: Over heat (OH1)
knowledge_items.description: Troubleshooting flow chart for drive overheat.
knowledge_items.remedy: Check if the heat sink temperature is greater than 90 C; reduce the load; check the cooling fan (change if it does not function normally, remove obstruction if jammed); check the surrounding temperature is within specification and adjust it; if temperature detection malfunctions contact DELTA.

knowledge_items.title: Overload (OL, OL1, OL2)
knowledge_items.description: Troubleshooting flow chart for overload OL1/OL2/OL.
knowledge_items.remedy: Check whether the load is too large (reduce load or increase the power of the AC motor drive); check settings at Pr.06-06 and Pr.06-07 and modify; otherwise contact DELTA.

knowledge_items.title: Keypad display abnormal
knowledge_items.description: Abnormal display or no display.
knowledge_items.remedy: Cycle power to the AC motor drive; check that all connectors are connected correctly and no noise is present (fix connector and eliminate noise); otherwise the AC motor drive has malfunction, contact DELTA.

knowledge_items.title: Phase loss (PHL)
knowledge_items.description: Troubleshooting flow chart for phase loss.
knowledge_items.remedy: Check wiring at R, S and T terminals and correct it; check that the terminal screws are tightened; check if the input voltage of R, S, T is unbalanced and check wiring and power system for abnormal power; otherwise contact DELTA.

knowledge_items.title: Motor cannot run
knowledge_items.description: Motor cannot run.
knowledge_items.remedy: Check keypad for normal display; check non-fuse breaker and magnetic contactor are ON; check input voltage is normal; check for faults such as Lv, PHL or disconnection and reset after clearing fault; check FWD/REV command and wiring of terminals MI1 and MI2-DCM; set the frequency; check torque compensation setting; check motor connection and output voltage at U, V, W; motor locked by large load: reduce load (e.g. check if a brake is released); upper bound frequency and setting frequency lower than the min. output frequency.

knowledge_items.title: Motor speed cannot be changed
knowledge_items.description: Motor can run but cannot change speed.
knowledge_items.remedy: Check if the max. frequency setting is too low; check if the frequency setting is out of the upper/lower bound range; check Pr.05-00 to Pr.05-14 are not all the same; check the 0-10V/4-20mA frequency signal and potentiometer; check wiring between MI1~MI6 and DCM; check accel/decel time is not very long and set suitable time by load inertia.

knowledge_items.title: Motor stalls during acceleration
knowledge_items.description: Motor stalls during acceleration.
knowledge_items.remedy: Check if acceleration time is too short and increase it; check if inertia of motor and load is too high; check for low voltage at input; check if load torque is too high (reduce load or increase drive capacity); check torque compensation and increase it; thicken or shorten the wiring between the motor and AC motor drive.

knowledge_items.title: Motor does not run as expected
knowledge_items.description: Motor does not run as expected.
knowledge_items.remedy: Check Pr.01-01 thru Pr.01-06 and torque compensation settings (adjust Pr.01-01 to Pr.01-06 and lower torque compensation); do not run in low speed continuously, use a special motor; check if output voltage of U, V, W is balanced; reduce load or increase drive capacity.

knowledge_items.title: Electromagnetic/induction noise
knowledge_items.description: Noise sources can cause malfunction of the control circuits and even damage the drive.
knowledge_items.remedy: 1. Add surge suppressor on the relays and contacts. 2. Shorten the wiring length of the control circuit or serial communication and keep it separated from the power circuit wiring. 3. Use shielded wires and isolation amplifiers for long length. 4. Ground the grounding terminal independently (not common with welding machines). 5. Connect a noise filter at the mains input terminal.

knowledge_items.title: Environmental condition
knowledge_items.description: Remedial measures for vibration, corrosion/humidity, temperature and humidity.
knowledge_items.remedy: Keep vibration within the specification (anti-vibration dampers are last choice); store in a clean and dry location free from corrosive fumes/dust (use dust-proof enclosure if necessary); keep ambient temperature within specification and periodically check air quality and the cooling fan; store within 0% to 90% RH non-condensing (use an air conditioner and/or exsiccator).

knowledge_items.title: Affecting other machines (high harmonics at power side)
knowledge_items.description: High harmonics at power side during running.
knowledge_items.remedy: 1. Separate the power system: use a transformer for the AC motor drive. 2. Use a reactor at the power input terminal of the AC motor drive. 3. If phase lead capacitors are used (never on the AC motor drive output) use serial reactors to prevent damage from high harmonics.

knowledge_items.title: Motor temperature rises
knowledge_items.description: Standard induction motor with fan has poor cooling at low speeds; high harmonics at the output increase copper and core losses.
knowledge_items.remedy: 1. Use a motor with independent ventilation (forced external cooling) or increase the motor rated power. 2. Use a special inverter duty motor. 3. Do NOT run at low speeds for long time.
